'''Belok Rhal''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who in [[44 ABY]] was contracted by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to lay [[Siege of the New Jedi Temple|siege]] to the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] in order to retrieve two fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Sothais Saar]] and [[Turi Altamik]]. The [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] agreed to send acting [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]]'s assistant, [[Kani Asari]], out to negotiate. When she appeared at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|entrance]] to the Jedi Temple, however, Rhal noted that she was neither Saar nor Altamik, and shot her on the spot, [[Death/Legends|killing]] her. Rhal once again showed his ruthlessness when he was deployed to [[Blaudu Sextus]] covertly by Daala to suppress the rebellion of the [[Octusi]] there. After mercilessly killing the Octusi elders, Rhal concentrated his fire on [[Madhi Vaandt]], killing her. He was later knocked unconscious and captured by [[Sothais Saar]] who turned him in to the authorities on Blaudu Sextus. Leia Organa Solo later remarked that the Blaudu Sextus leaders would have no choice but to prosecute him, otherwise it would appear that they approved of his crimes.<ref name="Vortex" />
